text: matchbook ran four tasks over a full session and .tasks/.index/paths.json stayed at {head:'',paths:{},tasks:{}} because the index is built from commits carrying Task: trailers and nothing was committed while a task was active. cairn related still answered, falling back to declared frontmatter targets and labelling the hit 'via declared targets, not commits' — so the feature the memory thesis rests on has not actually been exercised yet.

author: agent
text: confirmed the trailer mechanism is not broken, only conditional. matchbook installed both hooks at 10:51:53 and then committed 0f7b065 at 11:11:17 and bcb358f at 11:46:57 — neither carries a Task: trailer, because prepare-commit-msg exits 0 when .tasks/.active is absent or empty, and .tasks/.active was not written until 14:31:34 when cairn start first ran. So the index stays empty for any repo that commits before starting a task, which is the normal adoption order: init, then a few commits, then start.
